dict.string: TRACE reads what your camera sees into text on this iPhone and forgets the picture. Only the text goes to your own Mac.
TRACE sends the text it read to your own Mac on your local network. Nothing goes anywhere else.
TRACE turns what it hears into text on this iPhone and forgets the sound. Only the words go to your own Mac.
TRACE recognizes speech on this iPhone only (offline), so the words can be remembered without the audio.
